technical-summary: AS40 first increment. (1) validate-first probe: inspected the actually-installed pi-acp 0.0.32 bundle (previously undocumented -- prior AS27 probe against pi 0.80.10 found no separate pi-acp package) confirming PI_ACP_PI_COMMAND is the real spawn hook, argv is hardcoded to [--mode, rpc, --no-themes, (--session <path>)?], env is inherited from pi-acp's own process (already reachable via AcpLaunch.environment), stdio is fully piped, and stdout is consumed via readline with ANSI/prelude tolerance. (2) Implemented JsonlTapDecoder in providers/adapters/pi/rpc_tap.py: strict UTF-8 LF-delimited JSONL codec with bounded frame size and bounded parse-error tolerance for the AG-bound tap copy only, never raising (degrades evidence, never terminates the underlying session) -- 13 unit tests covering framing, split-chunk reassembly, CRLF, blank lines, oversized/invalid frames, and bounded-error exhaustion. Not yet built: the tee shim executable/process itself, socket/named-pipe transport, byte-transparency proof against the pi-acp-bound passthrough copy, and the concurrency/crash/cleanup proofs AS40 requires before this can close.
user-summary-candidate: Started AS40 (Pi RPC observation tap): probed the real pi-acp bridge's spawn mechanics and landed the strict JSONL frame codec with full test coverage. The tee-shim process and socket transport are the next piece.
